name: WdAlertLevel
description: Specifies the way certain alerts and messages are handled while a macro is running.

constants.name: wdAlertsNone
constants.description: No alerts or message boxes are displayed. If a macro encounters a message box, the default value is chosen and the macro continues.

constants.name: wdAlertsMessageBox
constants.description: Only message boxes are displayed; errors are trapped and returned to the macro.

constants.name: wdAlertsAll
constants.description: All message boxes and alerts are displayed; errors are returned to the macro.
